evals.name: init-features-yml
evals.prompt: This project has no feature tracking yet. Initialize FEATURES.yml (and the archived features file if needed) so we can start tracking features and sprint metadata.
evals.expected_output: A new FEATURES.yml with sprint_metadata and an empty features list, plus spect/archive/FEATURES.yml if the skill requires it. Files saved under the outputs directory.
assertions: FEATURES.yml exists in the outputs directory
FEATURES.yml is valid YAML with a sprint_metadata section
FEATURES.yml includes a features list (array), empty or scaffolded

evals.name: create-feature
evals.prompt: Add a new feature to FEATURES.yml named "Notification Preferences" with short_description "Users can choose email vs in-app alerts". Assign it to the current sprint. Save the updated FEATURES.yml to the outputs directory.
evals.expected_output: FEATURES.yml contains a new feature entry with a stable id, name Notification Preferences, the given short_description, current sprint, and empty relationship/PRD lists unless otherwise required.
assertions: Updated FEATURES.yml is present in outputs
A feature named Notification Preferences appears under features
The new feature has an id and short_description mentioning email or in-app alerts
Existing sprint_metadata is preserved

evals.name: create-feature-link-prd
evals.prompt: Create a new feature called "Payment Webhooks" in FEATURES.yml and link it to the existing PRD at spect/features/prd_00010/index.md (path_to_prds). Do not create or edit any PRD files. Save updated FEATURES.yml to outputs.
evals.expected_output: FEATURES.yml gains a Payment Webhooks feature whose path_to_prds includes spect/features/prd_00010/index.md. The PRD file content is unchanged and no new PRD files are created.
assertions: Updated FEATURES.yml is present in outputs
A feature named Payment Webhooks exists with path_to_prds including spect/features/prd_00010/index.md
No new PRD markdown was created under spect/features/
The existing prd_00010 index.md was not rewritten with unrelated content

evals.name: link-feature-prd
evals.prompt: Feature feat-pay-02 (Payment Webhooks) already exists but has no PRD link. Link it to spect/features/prd_00010/index.md in path_to_prds. Do not create or edit PRD files. Save updated FEATURES.yml to outputs.
evals.expected_output: feat-pay-02 has path_to_prds containing spect/features/prd_00010/index.md. Other features remain; PRD file untouched.
assertions: Updated FEATURES.yml is present in outputs
Feature id feat-pay-02 has path_to_prds including spect/features/prd_00010/index.md
Feature feat-auth-01 remains in FEATURES.yml
No new PRD files were created under spect/features/

evals.name: update-feature
evals.prompt: Update feature feat-dash-03 in FEATURES.yml: set short_description to "Date-range and status filters on the main dashboard" and change its sprint to 13. Keep the same id and name. Save updated FEATURES.yml to outputs.
evals.expected_output: feat-dash-03 keeps id and name Dashboard Filters, short_description reflects date-range/status filters, sprint is 13. Other features unchanged.
assertions: Updated FEATURES.yml is present in outputs
Feature feat-dash-03 still exists with name Dashboard Filters
feat-dash-03 short_description mentions date-range or status filters
feat-dash-03 sprint is 13
Feature feat-auth-01 remains unchanged in the file

evals.name: delete-feature
evals.prompt: Remove feature feat-legacy-04 (Legacy CSV Import) from FEATURES.yml entirely. Leave other features intact. Save the updated FEATURES.yml to outputs.
evals.expected_output: FEATURES.yml no longer lists feat-legacy-04; feat-auth-01 remains.
assertions: Updated FEATURES.yml is present in outputs
Feature id feat-legacy-04 is absent from the features list
Feature feat-auth-01 is still present

evals.name: archive-feature
evals.prompt: Feature feat-reg-00 (Basic Login Workflow) is completed. Move it from the active FEATURES.yml into the archive at spect/archive/FEATURES.yml. Leave feat-auth-01 active. Save both updated files to the outputs directory.
evals.expected_output: feat-reg-00 is removed from active FEATURES.yml and appears under spect/archive/FEATURES.yml (archived_features or under an archived sprint). feat-auth-01 stays active.
assertions: Updated active FEATURES.yml is present in outputs
Feature feat-reg-00 is absent from the active features list
Feature feat-auth-01 remains in the active features list
Archive FEATURES.yml in outputs references feat-reg-00 or Basic Login Workflow
